body:
I haven't reproduced this (yet), but I think I know what the problem is. In the getting-started quickstart, there is this https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-quickstarts/blob/main/getting-started/.s2i/environment#L3

    JAVA_OPTIONS=-Dquarkus.http.host=0.0.0.0

The original OpenJDK container behaviour of `JAVA_OPTIONS` was to have *only* user-provided JVM tuning parameters, and not script-provided. I.e.  if you define `JAVA_OPTIONS`, any JVM options  generated by the run script are ignored. To instead append to the script-generated JVM options, we added `JAVA_OPTS_APPEND`.

This behaviour broke at some point a long time ago, such that `JAVA_OPTIONS` overrode *some* of the run script-generated options, but not all -- notably, not the ones enabled by setting `JAVA_DEBUG`. And I think this (broken) behaviour has been in place for the whole lifetime of Quarkus.

In the latest version of the UBI8-based images, 1.17, we fixed this regression, so that `JAVA_OPTIONS` completely replaces the JVM generated options.

(Separately, `JAVA_OPTIONS` was deprecated and replaced by `JAVA_OPTS` (I've no idea why), but remained functional in the UBI8 images. (only `JAVA_OPTS` is supported in the UBI9 images.))

So: if you want to append to the script's options, use `JAVA_OPTS_APPEND`; if you want to replace them, use `JAVA_OPTS`.

Is it possible that a file like `.s2i/environment` is put in a new quarkus project skeleton by the new project generator?

(A related quick note about the .s2i/environment file in the getting-started quickstart. Recent version of the OpenJDK container, both ubi8 and ubi9, should auto-detect the correct paths for quarkus fast-jar and uber-jar build layouts, so MAVEN_S2I_ARTIFACT_DIRS, S2I_SOURCE_DEPLOYMENTS_FILTER, and JAVA_APP_JAR are not necessary. I guess you still want `-Dquarkus.http.host=0.0.0.0` so I would suggest defining `JAVA_OPTS_APPEND`.  `AB_JOLOKIA_OFF` is only necessary for UBI8-based images JDK versions 8 or 11: all JDK17 and all UBI9-based images have dropped Jolokia.)

I created the reproducer project with click on "START CODING" on https://quarkus.io/ and click on "Generate your application".  The generated project archive doesn't contain a file .s2i/environment.

[code-with-quarkus.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/12585816/code-with-quarkus.zip)

@TobiWeier 
Thanks for providing that ZIP, very useful
>  The generated project archive doesn't contain a file .s2i/environment.

Indeed, but `./src/main/docker/Dockerfile.jvm` defines `JAVA_OPTS` which behaves as described.

The fix is to change that to `JAVA_OPTS_APPEND`. I'll start filing PRs.

> The fix is to change that to JAVA_OPTS_APPEND. I'll start filing PRs.

Thanks @jmtd

issue.body:
The ENV JAVA_OPTS here is a configuration parameter for the base image ubi8/openjdk-17. In version :1.14, a bug prevented it from behaving as intended:  JAVA_OPTS is supposed to override all JVM tuning options from the run script, but it only overrode some of them.

Version :1.17 and newer of the ubi8/openjdk-17 container image changes the behaviour of JAVA_OPTS to properly override all run script parameters.

This was noticed in
<https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/35863>

The alternative variable JAVA_OPTS_APPEND is intended to provide extra parameters on top of those generated by the run script.

Switch to using JAVA_OPTS_APPEND instead of JAVA_OPTS. Take the opportunity to update to the latest base image version (:1.17).

body: I think there will be many PRs across the quarkus repositories to address this. Note that the fabric8 run-java script (a distant parent of the openjdk container run script) has different semantics: `JAVA_OPTIONS` appends, and neither `JAVA_OPTS` nor `JAVA_OPTS_APPEND` exist.

> I think there will be many PRs across the quarkus repositories to address this

Yeah, there are certainly a few :)

issue.title: JAVA_OPTS → JAVA_OPTS_APPEND, bump FROM version
issue.body:
In the Red Hat OpenJDK container images, the Env JAVA_OPTS configuration parameter is supposed to override all JVM tuning options generated by the run script. The related parameter JAVA_OPTS_APPEND is used to add to the script-generated parameters.

In image versions including :1.14 to :1.16, a bug prevented it from behaving as intended: JAVA_OPTS did not override all tuning parameters, only some of them.

This was noticed in
<https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/35863>

Version :1.17 and newer of the ubi8/openjdk-17 container image changes the behaviour of JAVA_OPTS to properly override all run script parameters.

Switch to using JAVA_OPTS_APPEND instead of JAVA_OPTS. Take the opportunity to update to the latest base image version (:1.17).

Note: The Fabric8 run-java script behaves differently: JAVA_OPTIONS appends, and neither JAVA_OPTS nor JAVA_OPTS_APPEND are supported. This commit does not touch Dockerfiles using the fabric8 run-java.
